title: From a vector to a choice
note: text = subtitles; say = spelled for the voice. Numbers from brain3d/trace.json, films/qkv_data.json, experiments/logs.

blocks.text: At the top of the stack, the last column is still 896 numbers. To speak, it has to become one token.
blocks.say: At the top of the stack, the last column is still eight hundred and ninety-six numbers. To speak, it has to become one token.

blocks.text: So it is compared with every row of the vocabulary table, all 151,936 of them. One dot product each: a score for every token. These scores are called logits.
blocks.say: So it is compared with every row of the vocabulary table, all one hundred and fifty-one thousand, nine hundred and thirty-six of them. One dot product each: a score for every token. These scores are called logits.

blocks.text: Softmax turns the logits into probabilities. We gets 56 percent. And one dial, the temperature, decides how sharp the choice is.
blocks.say: Softmax turns the logits into probabilities. We gets fifty-six percent. And one dial, the temperature, decides how sharp the choice is.

blocks.text: At temperature zero, the model always takes the top token. At 0.7, We rises to 82 percent, and the rest shrink. At 1.2, the bars flatten: We falls to 41, and unlikely tokens get a real chance.
blocks.say: At temperature zero, the model always takes the top token. At zero point seven, We rises to eighty-two percent, and the rest shrink. At one point two, the bars flatten: We falls to forty-one, and unlikely tokens get a real chance.

blocks.text: Then one token is drawn. Here, We. One token, chosen from 151,936.
blocks.say: Then one token is drawn. Here, We. One token, chosen from one hundred and fifty-one thousand, nine hundred and thirty-six.
